documents.text: [{"id":"F9795579a05716a54682f","question":"被夹紧的转子在 threshold 测量中是否停在 stop_angles_degrees 所列的止挡角上，而不是被耦合弹簧拉离到中间角度？","status":"released","facts":[{"statement":"Each bistable unit is a rigid bar free to rotate about a central pivot, corralled between two posts that restrict its rotation angle to an interval.","evidence_id":"E641bf80de789ac7156ec"},{"statement":"The two posts constrain the bar's angle to a bounded interval (the rotor's two states correspond to the two limits of that interval).","evidence_id":"E6a2e62e228c6436ae9b3"},{"statement":"In the reported threshold measurements, one rotor was held fixed in the (+) or (−) state while the driving rod was moved quasistatically until the other hysteron switched, i.e., thresholds were recorded with the non-measured rotor pinned in one of its two limit states.","evidence_id":"E70377c7a53dbea219d84"},{"statement":"Stable equilibria at intermediate angles between the two stop angles are avoided by making the driving springs sufficiently strong relative to coupling springs that could otherwise disrupt the two-state behavior.","evidence_id":"E2e171d35c48934b6f9b6"}],"scope":"Question-scoped case facts; not a scientific explanation or result."},{"id":"F4cfa34e29e0f44d46361","question":"threshold 行的 mount_l_cm 指被测（自由）转子一侧还是被夹紧转子一侧的耦合弹簧安装距离？两者在该表内是否取同一值？","status":"unknown","facts":[],"scope":"Question-scoped case facts; not a scientific explanation or result."}]
